text:
alex_k: FYI — customer hit 413 on /v1/embeddings when a client sent a mixed-dim batch with prefetch. Need quick decision on routing/policy.

maria: Found logs: https://logs/replay/abc — prefetch items were merged, payload doubled. dims seen: [768, 1536, 768].

sam: Question: are prefetch items counted/merged into the same ingress payload right now? I thought prefetch was a separate logical op.

ben: Runtime currently merges them if they arrive within the same batch window. That means the runtime only looks at bytes, not per-item dims, so mixed-dim -> cannot place on a single kernel -> 413.

alex_k: Two obvious options: 1) runtime auto-split mixed-dim batches into multiple engine calls (adds latency), 2) fast-fail/soft-fail prefetches or route them to dedicated pools.

maria: Console UX ask: surface an "estimated units" per request and mark prefetch lines so product teams see when prefetch could cause oversize.

sam: I'd also like a small preflight endpoint (/v1/embeddings/preflight) that returns an estimate and recommended split plan. Header idea: `X-Embeddings-Estimate` that clients can use to decide.

quota-bot: Quota check: tenant=acme has 98% monthly units used. Prefetch must count against same budget; otherwise we'll get surprising bill/fast-fail.

ben: Proposal: default runtime policy = `prefetch=favor-split` (try to split when possible). For enterprise/dedicated customers allow `prefetch=aggregate` opt-in.

alex_k: Also add telemetry flags: tag traces with `prefetch=true|false` and `split_strategy=auto|fastfail|aggregate`. Metric: `embeds.prefetch_413_count`.

maria: I'll open a console ticket to add estimate column + a preflight button on the routing dashboard. UX: show potential latency cost if splitting is recommended.

sam: I'll mock the preflight API in dev. Example request header we discussed:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
X-Embedding-Mode: prefetch
X-Embeddings-Estimate: 24
{
  "input": [ "..." ],
  "dims": [768,1536,768]
}
```

ben: :thumbsup: I'll start the runtime splitter PR and add the metric. Will ping @sam once there's a dev build to test.

alex_k: :eyes: goal = canary next week. If anyone has objections to `prefetch=favor-split` default, speak now.
